items.prompt: Which chart row shows the same vowel written once in hiragana and once in katakana?

items.evidence: Row A — あ / ア; both represent the vowel a.

items.prompt: Which row gives a three-character hiragana word meaning cherry blossom?

items.evidence: Row B — さくら; Sakura means cherry blossom.

items.prompt: Where does the chart show a katakana word containing the vowel-length mark ー?
